alexander.kim: Hey all — trying to align on how we surface request/span correlation in new runtime dashboards. We need a single request_id that ties API gateway -> runtime -> worker spans so Console can show per-request breakdowns. Thoughts on header format and sampling? 

maria_gomez: +1. runtime can emit W3C traceparent and a custom x-redwood-request-id. My preference is: runtime forwards traceparent, and we set x-redwood-request-id when absent. We also attach span tags: model_id, route, quant_profile.

sanjay.r: For Console dashboards we want 1) per-request latency waterfall 2) cost attribution per-span 3) sampling flag so aggregated charts know sample fraction. So we need a boolean sampled flag and the original trace id. Can we also include route_alias? 

maria_gomez: Yes to route_alias. Proposed payload (headers):

```http
traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01
x-redwood-request-id: rwd_1234abcd
x-redwood-sampled: 1
x-redwood-route: text.generate-v2
``` 

alexander.kim: That curl example was helpful; can runtime set x-redwood-sampled based on sampling policy (global percentage + per-customer override)? We want low-tier customers sampled at 5%, enterprise 100% for debugging.

maria_gomez: runtime can look up sampling config from config service. We'll add per-customer override in the request header check and fallback to policy. Implementation plan: emit spans with attribute "customer_id" and "sampled". If not sampled, still emit root metadata event to metrics so counts are correct.

dev-platform-bot: New ticket created: https://tracks.redwood/boards/INF-6123 — add trace headers + dashboard hooks (assigned: maria_gomez)

ops_ira: caution on logs: if we include full trace for every request at 100% for enterprise, storage blows up. Need retention plan and ability to toggle full-span retention per customer. Also, ensure PII redaction before spans hit logs.

maria_gomez: Agree. We'll emit minimal span metadata to tracing system and write full spans to S3/GCS only when retention enabled. Also will add scrubber stage in pipeline.

sanjay.r: UX ask: console should show sample rate metadata on dashboards and allow toggling to "show sample=1 only". Also surface a note when charts are sample-biased.

alexander.kim: Action items:
- maria: implement header propagation + sampling lookup (INF-6123)
- infra: add retention toggle + scrubber for spans (ops_ira to follow up)
- product/console: add sampled flag and sample-rate badge on charts (sanjay.r)

ops_ira: I'll draft a short runbook for on-call about tracing surges and storage alarms.

maria_gomez: I'll put a short design doc in the ticket with header spec, example spans, and config knobs. Will ping when ready for review :eyes:

alexander.kim: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
